create.name: Daryl Lynn Ross
create.bio:
Daryl Lynn Ross is an insight meditation teacher in Montréal who has taught for more than three decades. Her own practice has drawn on several Buddhist schools and on Christian contemplative mysticism, and more recently she has taken up the study of Kabbalah as a return to her Jewish roots. For twenty-two years she served as a university chaplain at Concordia, offering meditation and spiritual guidance to students and staff. In 2003 she co-founded True North Insight, Canada's bilingual insight community, where she is a guiding teacher and chairs the board. She has also trained in contemplative care for people at the end of life and offers spiritual companionship in that period.

Every Sunday morning she leads a sitting group at a studio near Snowdon metro that is also streamed on Zoom, and she runs longer retreats and courses, including a yearly silent retreat in the Laurentians that weaves daily yoga into body-based mindfulness practice. Her recorded Sunday talks work patiently through classic material such as the Satipatthana Sutta, the hindrances, the perfections and the factors of awakening. Her manner is gentle and unhurried, and students remark on the room she makes for questions from beginners and seasoned meditators. Like many teachers in this tradition, she offers most of her teaching on a donation basis.

courses.title: Abiding Mindfully in the Body: Meditation and Yoga Retreat (2026)
courses.description: A four-night silent residential retreat at Kio-o in the Laurentians, co-taught with David Schouela, centred on mindfulness of the body with two or three yoga sessions a day and practices of kindness and compassion.

courses.title: Abiding Mindfully in the Body: Meditation and Yoga Retreat (2027)
courses.description: Next year's edition of her autumn silent retreat in the Laurentians, again combining sitting and walking practice with daily yoga as meditation in movement. Registration is through True North Insight.

courses.title: Sunday Sangha
courses.description: Her weekly Sunday-morning meditation group, held in person at a studio near Snowdon metro in Montréal and online. Each session pairs a guided sit with a talk and time for questions; drop-in and open to all.

free_resources.title: Daryl Lynn Ross's Talks on Dharma Seed
free_resources.description: Her archive of recorded dharma talks and guided meditations from True North Insight retreats and groups. Free to stream.
